title: Tariff Annex: the Elapsed Contract Year on Workplace Cafe Management Program Contracts
content:
The contract year elapsed on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is dated either from the first service day recorded on the contract or from the first day of the contract term, and the contract record itself settles which of the two governs.

**(a) A first service day well after the term begins.** Where a first service day is recorded on the contract and it falls more than sixty calendar days after the first day of the contract term, the contract year elapsed is the whole months between the first service day and the day the settlement is worked out, reduced by whole years. The gap is measured in calendar days from the first day of the contract term to the first service day, and this paragraph is engaged only where that gap exceeds 60 calendar days: a gap of 60 calendar days is not more than 60 calendar days, while a gap of 61 calendar days is.

**(b) No first service day on the record.** Where no first service day is recorded on the contract, no month of the contract year has elapsed.

**(c) In any other case.** Otherwise the contract year elapsed is the whole months between the first day of the contract term and the day the settlement is worked out, reduced by whole years.

**Counting conventions.** Whole months are complete months between the two days named, a part month not yet complete on the day the settlement is worked out counting for nothing. Reducing by whole years takes off each complete run of 12 months, so the figure left standing is never as much as 12.

**Hypothetical records.** The lines below are hypothetical, each read against a settlement worked out on the hypothetical day 2025-02-10.

| Hypothetical contract record | Gap from the first day of the contract term | Contract year elapsed |
|---|---|---|
| Term first day 2023-03-15, first service day 2023-06-20 | 97 calendar days | Whole months from 2023-06-20 to 2025-02-10 are 19, which reduced by whole years is 7 |
| Term first day 2024-01-05, first service day 2024-03-05 | 60 calendar days | Whole months from 2024-01-05 to 2025-02-10 are 13, which reduced by whole years is 1 |
| Term first day 2024-01-05, no first service day recorded | no gap to measure | No month of the contract year has elapsed |

The second line sits on the boundary: a gap of exactly 60 calendar days does not carry the dating to the first service day, so the first day of the contract term remains the day the whole months are counted from.
